transcript.game_output_raw:
Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a cold and damp corridor where a long east-west passageway
intersects with a northward path.
>You are in a small chamber, which appears to have been part of a
coal mine. On the south wall of the chamber the letters "Granite
Wall" are etched in the rock. To the east is a long passage and
there is a steep metal slide twisting downward. From the appearance
of the slide, an attempt to climb up it would be impossible.  To the
north is a small opening.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are standing at the entrance of what might have been a coal
mine. To the northeast and the northwest are entrances to the mine,
and there is another exit on the south end of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>You are a small room.  Strange squeaky sounds may be heard coming from
the passage at the west end.  You may also escape to the south.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a small room which has only one door, to the east.
There is an exquisite jade figurine here.
A deranged giant vampire bat (a reject from WUMPUS) swoops down
from his belfry and lifts you away....
You are in a non-descript part of a coal mine.
>You are in a non-descript part of a coal mine.
>Beg pardon?
>

>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>Beg pardon?
>

>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.

 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.

axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.

of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.

>Beg pardon?

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>Beg pardon?
>

A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden

There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.

A sword

>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading

Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

out of the room.

>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.

>Beg pardon?

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Beg pardon?
>

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.

out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.

>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.

axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.

of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.

>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Beg pardon?

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room

Deep Canyon
>Round room
>Beg pardon?

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon

Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

walls.

out of the room.

axe.

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>Beg pardon?

#FUNCTION (("TUPLE" DIAG-A "AUX" DIAG-R) <DIAG-STATE> <SET DIAG-R <APPLY ,DIAG-ORIG-READSTRING !.DIAG-A>> <DIAG "READSTRING-COUNT" .DIAG-R> <DIAG "READSTRING-TEXT" <SUBSTRUC <1 .DIAG-A> 0 .DIAG-R>> .DIAG-R)
Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a cold and damp corridor where a long east-west passageway
intersects with a northward path.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a cold and damp corridor where a long east-west passageway
intersects with a northward path.
>You are in a small chamber, which appears to have been part of a
coal mine. On the south wall of the chamber the letters "Granite
Wall" are etched in the rock. To the east is a long passage and
there is a steep metal slide twisting downward. From the appearance
of the slide, an attempt to climb up it would be impossible.  To the
north is a small opening.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>Beg pardon?
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.

to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a cold and damp corridor where a long east-west passageway
intersects with a northward path.
>You are in a small chamber, which appears to have been part of a
coal mine. On the south wall of the chamber the letters "Granite
Wall" are etched in the rock. To the east is a long passage and
there is a steep metal slide twisting downward. From the appearance
of the slide, an attempt to climb up it would be impossible.  To the
north is a small opening.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are in a high north-south passage, which forks to the northeast.
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
East-West Passage
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>Round room
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
Deep Canyon
>Round room
>You are in a circular room with passages off in eight directions.
Your compass needle spins wildly, and you can't get your bearings.
>Unfortunately, it is impossible to tell directions in here.
You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a cold and damp corridor where a long east-west passageway
intersects with a northward path.
>You are in a small chamber, which appears to have been part of a
coal mine. On the south wall of the chamber the letters "Granite
Wall" are etched in the rock. To the east is a long passage and
there is a steep metal slide twisting downward. From the appearance
of the slide, an attempt to climb up it would be impossible.  To the
north is a small opening.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are standing at the entrance of what might have been a coal
mine. To the northeast and the northwest are entrances to the mine,
and there is another exit on the south end of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>You are a small room.  Strange squeaky sounds may be heard coming from
the passage at the west end.  You may also escape to the south.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>Beg pardon?
>
